resources.name: Lawyers Concerned for Lawyers of Pennsylvania (LCLPA)
resources.operator: Lawyers Concerned for Lawyers of Pennsylvania, Inc.
resources.confidential: 100% confidential; not affiliated with the Disciplinary Board and does not report participation
resources.cost: Free (incl. LCLPA-covered referrals to mental-health professionals)
resources.description: Statewide independent nonprofit (501(c)(3), founded 1988; IOLTA-funded) for Pennsylvania lawyers, judges, law students, and families: a confidential 24/7 helpline, peer support, intervention assistance, and covered professional referrals.

resources.name: Lawyers Helping Lawyers (Rhode Island Bar Association)
resources.operator: Rhode Island Bar Association (EAP contractor: CorpCare)

phones.label: Confidential 24/7 support line
phones.hoursNote: Official page: 'Counselors answer the phone 24/7 ... confidential, round the clock support'

resources.confidential: Confidential; Committee members hold statutory immunity/confidentiality (1991 RI Supreme Court rule)
resources.cost: Free to RI Bar members and their dependents (up to eight counseling sessions)
resources.description: The RI Bar Association's lawyer assistance program: a volunteer Lawyers Helping Lawyers Committee of peer attorneys plus a contracted EAP (CorpCare) providing confidential 24/7 assessment, referral, and counseling. Verified via an archived snapshot of the official ribar.com page (which names CorpCare as the contractor).

resources.name: Lawyers Helping Lawyers (SCLHL)
resources.operator: South Carolina Bar (clinical/EAP provider CuraLinc Healthcare)

phones.label: Confidential Helpline
phones.hoursNote: Page: answered '24 hours a day/seven days a week'; CuraLinc online support 24/7/365

resources.cost: Five free counseling sessions per year for each SC Bar member
resources.description: The SC Bar's LAP for lawyers, judges, and law students (substance use, mental illness, stress): a confidential 24/7 helpline, peer support, referral to treatment, five free annual counseling sessions (via clinical vendor CuraLinc), law-student assistance, Character & Fitness evaluations, and court-mandated monitoring oversight.

resources.name: Tennessee Lawyers Assistance Program (TLAP)
resources.operator: Tennessee Supreme Court / Administrative Office of the Courts
resources.confidential: Free, confidential and anonymous; TLAP members relieved of the duty to report ethical violations
resources.description: Statewide program established by the Tennessee Supreme Court (Rule 33), administered by the Administrative Office of the Courts: crisis counseling, consultation, intervention, referral, and long-term monitoring for lawyers, judges, bar applicants, and law students. Verified via tncourts.gov (tlap.org rendered but truncated).

resources.name: Lawyers Helping Lawyers (LHL)
resources.confidential: Under Utah RPC Rule 8.3 — 'what you say to LHL stays with LHL'
resources.description: Utah State Bar peer-support committee matching lawyers with one-on-one volunteer peer mentors for professional problems, substance use, mental illness, grief, and trauma. Provides confidential peer support (not treatment or evaluation).

resources.name: Tava Mental Health (Utah State Bar member benefit)
resources.operator: Tava Health (contracted by the Utah State Bar)
resources.description: Free, confidential teletherapy benefit sponsored by the Utah State Bar: video sessions with licensed clinicians via Tava's platform for active lawyers, Licensed Paralegal Practitioners, and Paralegal Division members.

resources.name: Vermont Lawyers Assistance Program (VT LAP)
resources.operator: Vermont Lawyers Assistance Program (listed via the Vermont Bar Association)

phones.label: Vermont Lawyers Assistance Program
phones.hoursNote: Number confirmed via the VBA wellness page; hours/cost not primary-verified

resources.description: Vermont's dedicated lawyer-assistance program (802-355-4352) for judges, lawyers, and law students, listed on the Vermont Bar Association's attorney-well-being page. NOTE: the former lapvt.org domain is DEFUNCT/parked (do not link it); operator identity, cost, and hours could not be primary-verified.

resources.name: Vermont Bar Assistance Program / Bar Counsel wellness contact
resources.operator: Vermont Judiciary Professional Responsibility Program (Bar Counsel)

phones.label: Bar Counsel (Professional Responsibility Program)
phones.hoursNote: Staffed office line; hours not printed

resources.description: Vermont Bar Counsel, via the Supreme Court's Professional Responsibility Program, provides attorneys and judges with wellness guidance, referrals, and educational materials (not clinical treatment). Distinct from the clinical VT LAP.

resources.name: Virginia Judges and Lawyers Assistance Program (VJLAP)
resources.operator: Virginia Judges and Lawyers Assistance Program (independent non-stock corporation)

phones.label: 24-Hour Confidential HelpLine
phones.hoursNote: VJLAP's own (archived) site: 'Call Our 24-Hour Confidential Help Line'

resources.description: Confidential, non-disciplinary help for lawyers, judges, law students, bar applicants, and families (substance use, chronic stress, mental health): information/referral, assessment, intervention, compliance monitoring, and family/staff support. Formerly Virginia Lawyers Helping Lawyers. Verified via an archived snapshot of vjlap.org.

resources.name: WSBA Member Wellness Program

phones.label: Member Wellness Program
phones.hoursNote: Contact invited for urgent situations; no 24/7 stated

resources.confidential: All services confidential (references Washington court rule APR 19)
resources.cost: Free of charge to WSBA members, law students, and those concerned about an attorney
resources.description: In-house wellness program with WSBA's own licensed clinicians: free confidential consultation/short-term therapy, ~50 attorney peer advisors statewide, substance-use referrals, job-seeker groups, and education. Includes a Judicial Assistance Service Program track for judicial officers.

resources.name: West Virginia Judicial & Lawyer Assistance Program (WVJLAP)
resources.operator: Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia
resources.confidential: Confidential absent express consent; independent of the Court, State Bar, and Office of Disciplinary Counsel
resources.description: Court-created (2013), confidential program: consultation, referral, intervention, crisis management, monitoring, and peer support for judges, attorneys, bar applicants, and law students. Runs weekly Zoom peer groups (Lawyers-in-Recovery Thu noon; Mental Health/Stress Mon noon).

resources.name: Wisconsin Lawyers Assistance Program (WisLAP)
resources.confidential: Confidential; callers need not disclose identity; exempt from reporting to the Office of Lawyer Regulation
resources.cost: Free as a benefit of State Bar membership
resources.description: State Bar of Wisconsin program on a 'Lawyers Helping Lawyers / Judges Helping Judges' model with 150+ trained volunteers: initial evaluation, referrals, consultation, monitoring, CLE/education, and well-being presentations for lawyers, judges, law students, and legal professionals.
